system.description: • Effect: Once per encounter, make a single ranged attack against any target you have line of sight to, regardless of range, cover, or obstruction — the shot arcs and curves as needed to arrive. No distance penalty, Half and Full Cover do not hinder it, and this attack cannot be a called shot (the trick is in the path, not the placement).

activities.name: The Arrow Finds Its Mark
activities.text: Make one ranged attack against any target in line of sight, ignoring range, cover and obstruction.
